prompt: The client wants to know why profit fell from 2023 to 2025. Which takeaway matters most?

exhibit.title: Revenue and cost of goods sold ($M)

options.text: Cost of goods sold rose faster than revenue, squeezing gross margin
options.feedback: Right. COGS grew 25% against 10% revenue growth; that is the profit story.
True, but it doesn't explain the profit decline.
The chart shows revenue rising each year.

options.text: The decline was caused by a new competitor
options.feedback: The chart has no competitor data.

explanation: Revenue rose 10% (200 to 220) while COGS rose 25% (120 to 150). Costs outgrew revenue, which is why profit fell.
